gbm_population_evidence.quote: High-grade Glioma; Brain Metastases; Brain Metastases, Adult
Suspicion for or histologically or cytologically confirmed and previously treated HGG or brain metastases from a primary extracranial malignancy

candidate_evidence.quote: [DIAGNOSTIC_TEST] 68Ga-PSMA-11 PET Scans: Participants will be injected intravenously with 68Ga-PSMA-11 via intravenous catheter.
Assess range of tumor uptake of 68Ga-PSMA-11 in participants

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Participants with newly diagnosed or recurrent high-grade glioma/HGG or brain metastases

role_evidence.quote: The purpose of this study is to find out whether 68Ga-PSMA-11 PET/CT is effective in assessing tumor uptake (tumor activity seen in cancerous tissue) in participants with high-grade glioma/HGG or brain metastases.

agents.drug_class_hint: gallium-68 labelled PSMA-targeting PET imaging tracer (PSMA-11; possibly INN gozetotide, not stated in record); isotope 68Ga

coder_notes: Diagnostic PET imaging study only (Early Phase 1). Population is high-grade glioma or brain metastases; glioblastoma is not named anywhere in conditions, title, eligibility or arm labels, so not_glioblastoma-type exclusion (high_grade_glioma_unspecified). 18F-FDG PET and contrast CT/MR are standard clinical care, not registered interventions, so not listed. PSMA tumour uptake is an imaging measure, not recorded as a molecular biomarker.
